editorial:
Imagine a guy gets out of prison and decides he has exactly one day to settle every single score on his list. That is the hook here. You get a silent killer who does not say a word while he tears through the city, and a detective who has already lost his reputation trying to stop him. It feels like a race against the clock from the very start. The vibe is gritty and tense, making you feel the pressure as the hours tick down. You will find yourself rooting for the detective to figure out the pattern before it is too late.

What really works is how the movie keeps you guessing about the killer's motive. The action scenes are punchy and the pacing never lets up, though some of the side characters feel a bit flat. If you love crime thrillers that move fast, you should definitely give this a shot.
endingExplained: You find out the killer was not just acting on random rage. The final twist reveals that the people he killed were actually part of a cover-up that framed him years ago. In the last few scenes, the detective realizes the killer was actually the victim. They have a final showdown where the killer completes his list and finally finds peace, while the detective uses the evidence found to clear the man's name posthumously.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves revenge stories and police procedurals.
